findings.title: Public internal-transition API bypasses review and Completion Gate
findings.required_fix: Make reducer-owned transition commit inaccessible to ordinary callers or require an unforgeable, operation-specific internal capability. Validate runner-state/event correspondence so node.passed requires the exact validated independent-review record, and task.completed can only be committed by a current successful CompletionGate assessment. Add public-API regressions proving direct node.passed and task.completed injection causes zero writes.

findings.title: PASS closes a stable finding without required body-digest progress
findings.required_fix: Before a PASS review closes an open finding or passes the revised node, require the current candidate body digest to differ from the digest bound to that finding/prior REVISE review. Route same-digest PASS to deterministic non-convergence escalation and add a Revise-then-PASS same-digest regression.
